text: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
Then the man said, "This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man."
But the LORD God called to the man and said to him, "Where are you?"
Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know; am I my brother's keeper?"
And God said to Noah, "I have determined to make an end of all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth."
I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
Come, let us go down and there confuse their language, so that they may not understand one another's speech.
Now the LORD said to Abram, "Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you."
And he believed the LORD, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you, about this time next year, and Sarah shall have a son.
And Sarah said, "God has made laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh over me."
Abraham said, "God will provide for himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son." So they went both of them together.
Esau said, "I am about to die; of what use is a birthright to me?"
Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.
So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him but a few days because of the love he had for her.
Then he said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel, for you have striven with God and with men, and have prevailed."
And Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood; throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him"—that he might rescue him out of their hand to restore him to his father.
You shall be over my house, and all my people shall order themselves as you command. Only as regards the throne will I be greater than you.
So Joseph said to his brothers, "Come near to me, please." And they came near. And he said, "I am your brother, Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt."
As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.
